Supreme Court questions delay in disqualifying 20 TMC MPs

The Supreme Court has raised questions regarding the delay by the Lok Sabha Speaker in deciding on the disqualification of 20 "rebel" Trinamool Congress (TMC) MPs. The issue has resurfaced following remarks made by the apex court. The coverage includes a heated debate in the Supreme Court concerning these MPs and a judge's expressed concern over the Speaker's inaction.
